verification.stimulus: Validate identical repeated bytes, then alter only non-semantic metadata on the nested copy so both bodies retain the same four-field reference identity.

verification.expectedEvidenceState: The runner reports the literal assertion: a v2 session rejects byte-distinct resource bodies that claim one exact four-field identity
